summary: Verified new Admin User Management feature end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/10 pass: admin login as Mrterpenes@gmail.com works, /api/admin/users lists users (no _id / no password_hash), exactly ONE admin exists in DB (mrterpenes@gmail.com), non-admin gets 403 on all admin/users endpoints, unauthenticated request returns 401/403, primary admin protected from delete AND from password reset, reset password enforces min 6 chars, admin can reset a customer's password and the customer can log in with the new one, admin can delete a customer and it 404s afterward. Frontend UI at /admin/users renders 17 registered users, Mr. Terpenes card shows 'Admin' badge + 'Protected account' label with no action buttons, all 16 other users have Reset Password and Delete buttons, search filter works (typing 'mrterpenes' narrows to 1 card), Reset Password dialog opens with password input + confirm button, Delete User Account confirm dialog opens showing user email + Cancel/Delete User buttons.

issues: Short-password (< 6 chars) validation did not surface a visible toast/inline error during quick UI probe. Backend correctly returns 400 (verified in pytest). Recommend surfacing the API error message to the user (or add client-side min-length validation with a helper text) so users get feedback when password is too short.

passed_tests: GET /api/admin/users returns list without _id/password_hash; exactly 1 is_admin=true (Mrterpenes@gmail.com)
Non-admin session -> 403 on GET /api/admin/users and DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}
Admin reset a customer's password; customer logged in with new password
Admin deleted a TEST_ customer; subsequent GET returned 404
UI: /admin/users loads UserManager, 17 cards, admin has Protected label, 16 Reset + 16 Delete buttons
UI: search input filters cards by email
UI: Reset Password dialog opens with new-password-input + confirm-reset-password-btn
UI: Delete User confirm dialog opens with confirm-delete-user-btn
action_items: Optional UX: surface reset-password API error message (or add client-side validation) in the Reset Password dialog when password < 6 chars - currently no visible feedback in UI.

Optional a11y: previously flagged Radix DialogContent 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' warning still applies to Reset Password and Delete User dialogs in UserManager - add <DialogDescription> for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup_event correctly demotes any user other than ADMIN_EMAIL from is_admin=True on every startup and always ensures ADMIN_EMAIL has is_admin=true + valid password_hash. Good pattern, but note it runs on every restart and will overwrite any manual admin bootstrapping.
Admin protection uses env var ADMIN_EMAIL for case-insensitive compare in update/reset/delete endpoints - correct and consistent.
GET /api/admin/users projects out _id and password_hash - good. But GET /api/admin/users/{user_id} does the same, consistent.

PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id} does not allow role/is_admin changes (only first_name/last_name/phone) - matches requirement 'admin cannot change roles'. Registration endpoint /api/auth/register also does not accept is_admin field (verified via schema).
UserManager.jsx does not show the API error message on failed reset-password (e.g. min length); consider adding a toast on catch to surface backend detail.

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ customer users via /api/auth/register during pytest; one was deleted by test_delete_customer_user, one remains (TEST_user_*) with reset password 'NewSecure123!' - safe to leave or clean up manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin User Management feature is fully functional end-to-end. Only nit: reset-password client-side error toast not visible when password is too short (backend 400 works, UI silent). Admin exclusivity enforced via startup_event demoting other admins + protection in update/reset/delete endpoints.
